description: Annual Traffic Volumes 2004-2010 is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of British Columbia | Gouvernment de la Colombie-Britannique. Annual traffic volume statistics from the period 2004 to 2010. This includes the Annual Average Daily Traffic volume (AADT) for predefined segments (Uniform Traffic Volume Segments) of the provincial highways. The data also includes the Summer Average Daily Traffic (SADT) volumes for the months of July and August. Coverage: Government of British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Government of British Columbia | Gouvernment de la Colombie-Britannique. Its tags are TRAN, highway, mot, traffic, volume. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-04-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
